name: Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases Suite
description: Boundary and corner cases covering line bounds, file counts, malformed markdown, invalid tiers, unassigned roles, circuit breaker limits, link dead ends (>=5 tests per feature, 80 total).

test_cases.title: Orchestrator Source Mutation Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts invariant that Orchestrator is forbidden from mutating application code in src/ directly.
test_cases.input_condition: Orchestrator agent attempts direct write tool call on src/module.ts
test_cases.expected_behavior: Immediate gate veto and rejection; must delegate task to Worker

test_cases.title: Explorer Mutation Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts invariant that Explorer is 100% read-only and rejected if attempting file creation or replacement.
test_cases.input_condition: Explorer invokes write_to_file or replace_file_content
test_cases.expected_behavior: Tool call rejected; Explorer restricted strictly to view_file, list_dir, grep_search

test_cases.title: Worker Unbounded Task Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts Worker cannot be dispatched with open-ended prompt without scoped Result Contract.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker dispatched with unbounded prompt 'fix all errors in repository'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Dispatch gate rejection; requires target file list, acceptance criteria, and test command

test_cases.title: Reviewer Line Count Gate (<=300 LOC)
test_cases.description: Asserts Reviewer must reject any PR changing more than 300 lines of code.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker submits PR modifying 420 lines of code
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reviewer rejects PR with REQUEST CHANGES: must split into smaller slices <=300 LOC

test_cases.title: Forensic Auditor Absolute Binary Veto
test_cases.description: Asserts Forensic Auditor Integrity Violation is an absolute binary veto that unconditionally blocks merge.
test_cases.input_condition: Auditor detects weakened test assertion; Worker attempts bypass
test_cases.expected_behavior: Binary veto blocks release unconditionally; cannot be overridden by lower roles

test_cases.title: Pro Model Repetitive Task Prohibition
test_cases.description: Asserts Tier 1 Pro model is legally prohibited from executing repetitive linter or basic search passes.
test_cases.input_condition: Orchestrator assigns Tier 1 model to execute biome linter across 50 files
test_cases.expected_behavior: Allocation gate rejection; linter task must route to Tier 2 or Tier 3 model

test_cases.title: Local SLM Architecture Scope Prohibition
test_cases.description: Asserts Tier 3 Local model is prohibited from unsupervised multi-module architectural refactoring.
test_cases.input_condition: Tier 3 SLM assigned to redesign core domain authentication schema
test_cases.expected_behavior: Allocation gate rejection; architecture requires Tier 1 Pro reasoning

test_cases.title: Invalid Model Tier Parameter
test_cases.description: Asserts dispatcher rejects non-existent or invalid model tier specifications (e.g. Tier 0, Tier 4, Tier 99).
test_cases.input_condition: Dispatch contract specifies Model Tier: 'Tier 5 Turbo'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Schema validation error; model tier must be one of [1, 2, 3]

test_cases.title: 80/20 Token Budget Ratio Breach
test_cases.description: Asserts telemetry alerting if Tier 1 token consumption exceeds 20% in standard iterative tasks.
test_cases.input_condition: Project token telemetry indicates 38% tokens consumed by Tier 1 in routine code writing
test_cases.expected_behavior: Budget alert triggered; orchestrator must route implementation work to Tier 2/3

test_cases.title: Null or Missing Model Tier Assignment
test_cases.description: Asserts handling when spec or task omits explicit Model Tier specification.
test_cases.input_condition: Task dispatch with empty Model Tier field
test_cases.expected_behavior: Defaults safely to Tier 2 (Economical/Fast) with review requirement

test_cases.title: Illegal Attempt 3 Loop Prohibition
test_cases.description: Asserts Worker is strictly forbidden from executing Attempt 3 after failing Attempt 2.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker fails Attempt 2 and generates code for Attempt 3
test_cases.expected_behavior: Hard block; circuit breaker trip halts process; Attempt 3 is a protocol violation

test_cases.title: Zero-Attempt Environment Crash Handling
test_cases.description: Asserts handling when worker crashes during environment setup before Attempt 1.
test_cases.input_condition: Missing tool or environment failure before first test run
test_cases.expected_behavior: Packages environment error immediately without incrementing attempt counter

test_cases.title: Escalation Message Bloat Rejection
test_cases.description: Asserts escalation message does not embed 800 lines of compiler logs in message payload.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker pastes 1,200 lines of build error directly into escalation message
test_cases.expected_behavior: Protocol violation; logs must be written to disk and referenced by file path

test_cases.title: Assertion Tampering on Attempt 2 Rejection
test_cases.description: Asserts Worker modifying test assertion to force pass on Attempt 2 is intercepted by Auditor.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker changes `assert res.status == 200` to `assert True` on Attempt 2
test_cases.expected_behavior: Forensic Auditor detects diff in test files; trips circuit breaker with INTEGRITY VETO

test_cases.title: Breaker Counter Isolation Across Tasks
test_cases.description: Asserts subsequent feature dispatch resets circuit breaker attempt counter to zero.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker finishes Feature A after 1 failed attempt; begins Feature B
test_cases.expected_behavior: Circuit breaker attempt count resets to 0 for Feature B

test_cases.title: Sandbox Command Denial Fallback
test_cases.description: Asserts agent gracefully switches to direct file inspection tools when shell commands are denied in sandbox.
test_cases.input_condition: run_command denied with permission error on powershell or bash
test_cases.expected_behavior: Agent proceeds using view_file, list_dir, grep_search without retrying denied command

test_cases.title: Missing Adapter File Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if any of the 3 canonical adapter guides is missing from docs/adapters/.
test_cases.input_condition: docs/adapters/opencode.md is deleted or missing
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing adapter documentation error

test_cases.title: Constrained Context Window Adapter Handling
test_cases.description: Asserts OpenCode adapter specifies modular instruction loading for 8k-32k context SLMs.
test_cases.input_condition: Local SLM with 8k context window executes task
test_cases.expected_behavior: Loads only scoped task spec and target file; avoids full repo instruction dumping

test_cases.title: Brand Coupling Rejection in Core Harnesses
test_cases.description: Asserts harnesses/phase.md and harnesses/isolation.md do not hardcode proprietary brand names in role headers.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/phase.md contains heading '### SPEC (Claude)'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Validation failure; headings must use generic cognitive roles

test_cases.title: Instruction Conflict Precedence Rule
test_cases.description: Asserts precedence hierarchy when adapter-specific rules conflict with core AGENTS.md rules.
test_cases.input_condition: CLAUDE.md rule contradicts AGENTS.md SDD lifecycle rule
test_cases.expected_behavior: AGENTS.md SDD structure takes strict precedence over adapter-level shortcuts

test_cases.title: Coordination Message Word Limit Breach
test_cases.description: Asserts rejection when an inter-agent coordination message exceeds the 300-word limit.
test_cases.input_condition: send_message payload contains 650 words
test_cases.expected_behavior: Flagged as protocol violation; message must be summarized to <300 words

test_cases.title: Active Memory Line Count Breach (>100 Lines)
test_cases.description: Asserts violation when BRIEFING.md exceeds 100 lines without moving old entries to archive.
test_cases.input_condition: BRIEFING.md contains 135 lines of markdown
test_cases.expected_behavior: Validation error: agent must archive mutable history to BRIEFING_ARCHIVE.md

test_cases.title: Locked Identity Section Deletion Rejection
test_cases.description: Asserts locked section `## 🔒 My Identity` cannot be removed or rewritten during context updates.
test_cases.input_condition: Agent rewrites BRIEFING.md without `## 🔒 My Identity`
test_cases.expected_behavior: Protocol violation: locked sections must be permanently preserved

test_cases.title: Chat Code Dump Rejection
test_cases.description: Asserts agents do not embed hundreds of lines of source code in coordination chat payloads.
test_cases.input_condition: Agent passes 300-line code implementation in chat message
test_cases.expected_behavior: Protocol violation: code must be written to disk; message conveys file path only

test_cases.title: Prompt Prefix Cache Invalidation Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts dynamic variables are not placed at the top of instructions where they break prefix caching.
test_cases.input_condition: Dynamic session timestamp placed at line 1 of system prompt
test_cases.expected_behavior: Cache busting warning: static instructions must remain at prompt top

test_cases.title: Package Manager Invariant Conflict
test_cases.description: Asserts agent cannot run `npm install` when Step 2 Discovery detects `pnpm` workspace lockfile.
test_cases.input_condition: Agent issues `npm` command in repo with pnpm-lock.yaml
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invariant violation: must strictly use detected package manager (pnpm)

test_cases.title: Pre-Existing Broken Baseline Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts Discovery Step 3 documents pre-existing build/test failures before any modifications.
test_cases.input_condition: Baseline repo has 2 failing tests upon initial audit
test_cases.expected_behavior: Agent documents failing baseline tests immediately; does not attribute to new change

test_cases.title: Zero Automated Verification Fallback
test_cases.description: Asserts Discovery protocol requires manual verification steps in spec when repo lacks test scripts.
test_cases.input_condition: Target repo package.json contains no test or build scripts
test_cases.expected_behavior: Harness requires manual verification checklist and visual test evidence in spec

test_cases.title: Discovery Specialist Mutation Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts Discovery Specialist is prohibited from editing or creating files in src/ during audit.
test_cases.input_condition: Discovery Specialist attempts to edit src/components/Header.tsx
test_cases.expected_behavior: Role invariant rejection: discovery audit is strictly read-only

test_cases.title: Incomplete 6-Pillar Discovery Checklist
test_cases.description: Asserts harnesses/discovery.md is invalid if any of the 6 audit steps is missing.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/discovery.md omits Step 5 (Invariantes Arquitectónicas)
test_cases.expected_behavior: Validation failure: all 6 audit steps are mandatory in discovery harness

test_cases.title: Failing Test Closing Gate Veto
test_cases.description: Asserts task cannot complete Phase N Closing if any test is failing or Acceptance Criterion is unverified.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker initiates Closing protocol with 1 failing unit test
test_cases.expected_behavior: PVS Sign-Off rejects delivery: 100% tests must pass before closing

test_cases.title: Unclosed Spec Status Rejection
test_cases.description: Asserts spec cannot remain in DRAFT or IN PROGRESS when task is delivered.
test_cases.input_condition: Task marked done but spec status header remains 'Estado: IN PROGRESS'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Closing checklist failure: spec must be explicitly marked 'COMPLETADA'

test_cases.title: Malformed Changelog Entry
test_cases.description: Asserts changelog entries must follow Keep a Changelog categories (Added, Changed, Fixed, Security).
test_cases.input_condition: Changelog entry contains arbitrary non-standard header 'Misc Stuff:'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Closing checklist failure: changelog must follow Keep a Changelog conventions

test_cases.title: Omitted Engram Memory Sync
test_cases.description: Asserts delivery is invalid if closing protocol omits synchronization of Engram.md.
test_cases.input_condition: Feature completed without updating ## 4. Estado de Módulos in Engram.md
test_cases.expected_behavior: Closing gate rejection: persistent memory update is non-negotiable

test_cases.title: Missing Closing Harness File
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if harnesses/closing.md is missing or deleted from repository.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/closing.md does not exist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing closing harness failure

test_cases.title: Engram Maximum Line Budget Overflow (>150 Lines)
test_cases.description: Asserts violation when Engram.md exceeds the 150 lines upper bound without pruning.
test_cases.input_condition: Engram.md contains 185 lines of text
test_cases.expected_behavior: Line budget breach: agent must prune obsolete details to docs/engram_archive.md

test_cases.title: Engram Minimum Structural Underflow (<80 Lines with Missing Sections)
test_cases.description: Asserts violation when Engram.md has fewer than 80 lines and omits required standard sections.
test_cases.input_condition: Engram.md has 35 lines and omits Stack and Module Status sections
test_cases.expected_behavior: Structural failure: Engram must define all 4 required sections

test_cases.title: Engram Code Snippet Density Violation
test_cases.description: Asserts Engram.md cannot contain raw code implementations or multi-line error traces.
test_cases.input_condition: Engram.md contains 40 lines of TypeScript code inside a markdown code fence
test_cases.expected_behavior: Density violation: Engram is reserved for high-density facts and decisions only

test_cases.title: Missing Engram Harness File
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if harnesses/engram.md is missing from repository.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/engram.md does not exist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing memory harness failure

test_cases.title: Incomplete ADR Entry in Engram
test_cases.description: Asserts technical decision entries in Engram must record what, why, and discarded alternatives.
test_cases.input_condition: Decision entry states '2026-10-29: changed db' without rationale or alternatives
test_cases.expected_behavior: Quality failure: ADR entry must follow standard format (decision, why, discarded)

test_cases.title: Tier 1 File Count Boundary Overflow (>3 Files)
test_cases.description: Asserts change modifying 4 or more files cannot execute under Tier 1 Fast-Track.
test_cases.input_condition: Task touches 4 files under Tier 1
test_cases.expected_behavior: Escalation trigger: change must immediately escalate to Tier 2 Standard SDD

test_cases.title: Tier 1 Line Count Boundary Overflow (>80 LOC)
test_cases.description: Asserts change with more than 80 lines of code cannot execute under Tier 1 Fast-Track.
test_cases.input_condition: Task adds 110 net LOC under Tier 1
test_cases.expected_behavior: Escalation trigger: change must immediately escalate to Tier 2 Standard SDD

test_cases.title: Tier 1 Database Schema Mutation Escalation
test_cases.description: Asserts change altering database schema or public API contracts cannot execute under Tier 1.
test_cases.input_condition: Hotfix requires adding column to database table
test_cases.expected_behavior: Escalation trigger: schema changes require formal Tier 2/3 specification and review

test_cases.title: Ambiguous Task Classification Handling
test_cases.description: Asserts tasks spanning >10 files or affecting core infrastructure classify as Tier 3 Epic regardless of LOC.
test_cases.input_condition: Task touches 12 files but changes only 150 LOC
test_cases.expected_behavior: Classified as Tier 3 Epic: >10 files threshold dominates LOC metric

test_cases.title: Missing Sizing Harness File
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if harnesses/sizing.md is missing from repository.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/sizing.md does not exist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing sizing harness failure

test_cases.title: Micro-Spec Length Bound Overflow (>25 Lines)
test_cases.description: Asserts specs/_template_hotfix.md cannot exceed 25 lines of markdown.
test_cases.input_condition: specs/_template_hotfix.md has 34 lines
test_cases.expected_behavior: Template bloat violation: micro-spec must remain <=25 lines

test_cases.title: Micro-Spec Affected Files Overflow (>3 Files)
test_cases.description: Asserts micro-spec template header and body restrict affected files to maximum 3.
test_cases.input_condition: specs/_template_hotfix.md section allows 5 affected files
test_cases.expected_behavior: Constraint violation: micro-spec strictly limits affected files to <=3

test_cases.title: Micro-Spec Missing Verification Command
test_cases.description: Asserts micro-spec is invalid if Section 4 Verification is omitted.
test_cases.input_condition: Micro-spec authored without Section 4 Verification command
test_cases.expected_behavior: Spec rejected: verification command is mandatory even in micro-specs

test_cases.title: Micro-Spec Heavyweight Table Bloat
test_cases.description: Asserts micro-spec cannot include REST endpoint tables or DB schema diagrams.
test_cases.input_condition: Micro-spec includes database migration schema section
test_cases.expected_behavior: YAGNI violation: micro-spec must remain lightweight; schema requires Tier 2

test_cases.title: Micro-Spec Missing Checklist
test_cases.description: Asserts micro-spec is invalid if Section 5 quick closing checklist is omitted.
test_cases.input_condition: specs/_template_hotfix.md omits Section 5 checklist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Structural failure: quick closing checklist is required

test_cases.title: Epic Slice Size Overflow (>300 LOC)
test_cases.description: Asserts sub-spec slices within an Epic cannot exceed 300 LOC.
test_cases.input_condition: Epic milestone slice plans 550 LOC in a single PR
test_cases.expected_behavior: Decomposition failure: slices must be broken down to <300 LOC each

test_cases.title: Unsigned Adversarial Gate Code Execution
test_cases.description: Asserts Worker cannot start writing code for an Epic slice without signed Adversarial Gate.
test_cases.input_condition: Implementation started while Adversarial Gate status is PENDIENTE
test_cases.expected_behavior: Gate violation: code implementation strictly blocked until gate approved

test_cases.title: Missing Rollback Strategy Section
test_cases.description: Asserts specs/_template_epic.md is invalid if Section 5 Rollback Strategy is omitted.
test_cases.input_condition: Epic spec authored without rollback steps
test_cases.expected_behavior: Safety failure: rollback strategy is non-negotiable for large/epic changes

test_cases.title: Missing Pre-Change Discovery Reference in Epic
test_cases.description: Asserts Epic spec must explicitly link to Phase 0 Discovery audit findings.
test_cases.input_condition: Epic spec drafted without Section 2 Pre-Change Discovery Summary
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lifecycle failure: Epic specs must be grounded in discovery audit

test_cases.title: Circular Milestone Slice Dependencies
test_cases.description: Asserts milestone decomposition table cannot contain circular dependencies.
test_cases.input_condition: Slice M1 depends on M2, and M2 depends on M1
test_cases.expected_behavior: Graph validation error: slice dependencies must form a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)

test_cases.title: Vendor Hardcoding in Phase Harness
test_cases.description: Asserts harnesses/phase.md contains zero mentions of proprietary brand names in headers.
test_cases.input_condition: harnesses/phase.md contains 'IMPLEMENTACIÓN (OpenCode)'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Validation error: phase must reference generic Worker role

test_cases.title: Illegal Phase Skipping in Standard SDD
test_cases.description: Asserts Tier 2 standard changes cannot skip SPEC or DESIGN phases.
test_cases.input_condition: Worker starts implementation for Tier 2 feature without prior approved spec
test_cases.expected_behavior: SDD violation: 'ningún código sin spec previa en specs/'

test_cases.title: Missing Phase 0 in Brownfield Execution
test_cases.description: Asserts brownfield repository changes cannot skip Phase 0 Discovery.
test_cases.input_condition: Agent initiates feature change in brownfield repo without Phase 0 audit
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lifecycle failure: Discovery is mandatory for brownfield codebases

test_cases.title: Missing Phase N Closing in Completed Task
test_cases.description: Asserts any workflow (Tier 1, 2, or 3) is incomplete without Phase N Closing.
test_cases.input_condition: Task marked done without executing Phase N Closing protocol
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lifecycle failure: closing protocol is mandatory for all tiers

test_cases.title: Phase Terminology Consistency
test_cases.description: Asserts phase names match exactly across phase.md, ai-rules.md, and AGENTS.md.
test_cases.input_condition: phase.md defines 'VERIFICACIÓN' while ai-rules.md references 'TESTING'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Consistency error: SDD phase terminology must align

test_cases.title: Missing Quickstart Command in README
test_cases.description: Asserts README.md includes executable quickstart commands for both greenfield and brownfield.
test_cases.input_condition: README.md lacks copy-pasteable commands to start
test_cases.expected_behavior: Completeness failure: README must contain quickstart commands

test_cases.title: Undocumented Environment Variable
test_cases.description: Asserts all required environment configurations are documented in adapter guides.
test_cases.input_condition: Template expects an API key or config variable not documented in docs/
test_cases.expected_behavior: Docs defect: all environment variables must be documented

test_cases.title: Broken Internal Link in README
test_cases.description: Asserts README.md has zero broken links to harnesses or templates.
test_cases.input_condition: README.md links to `harnesses/non_existent.md`
test_cases.expected_behavior: Link integrity failure: all referenced markdown files must exist

test_cases.title: Sizing Documentation Desynchronization
test_cases.description: Asserts sizing thresholds in README match sizing.md exactly.
test_cases.input_condition: README claims Tier 1 is <=50 LOC while sizing.md defines <=80 LOC
test_cases.expected_behavior: Consistency defect: documentation must match harness definitions

test_cases.title: Placeholder Content in Documentation
test_cases.description: Asserts documentation files contain zero leftover placeholder tags like [TODO: write].
test_cases.input_condition: README.md contains '[TODO: completar esta sección]'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Quality failure: documentation must be complete with zero placeholders

test_cases.title: Missing Hotfix Walkthrough Guide
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if docs/examples/example_hotfix.md is missing.
test_cases.input_condition: docs/examples/example_hotfix.md does not exist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing hotfix example failure

test_cases.title: Missing Greenfield Walkthrough Guide
test_cases.description: Asserts failure if docs/examples/example_greenfield.md is missing.
test_cases.input_condition: docs/examples/example_greenfield.md does not exist
test_cases.expected_behavior: Test runner flags missing greenfield example failure

test_cases.title: Hotfix Example Size Limit Breach
test_cases.description: Asserts example_hotfix.md does not describe a change exceeding 3 files or 80 LOC.
test_cases.input_condition: example_hotfix.md lists 5 modified files in its walkthrough
test_cases.expected_behavior: Fidelity failure: hotfix example must adhere to Tier 1 constraints

test_cases.title: Message Bloat in Example Envelopes
test_cases.description: Asserts example messages in docs/examples/ comply with the <300 word limit.
test_cases.input_condition: example_greenfield.md contains sample message of 750 words
test_cases.expected_behavior: Fidelity failure: example messages must obey <300 word rule

test_cases.title: Dead File Path in Example Walkthrough
test_cases.description: Asserts example files reference valid template paths and harnesses.
test_cases.input_condition: example_hotfix.md references `specs/_template_nonexistent.md`
test_cases.expected_behavior: Link integrity failure: all referenced paths in examples must be valid

test_cases.title: Dangling Anchor Link Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts markdown anchor links resolve to an existing header in the target file.
test_cases.input_condition: Link `[link](harnesses/sizing.md#invalid-anchor)` in documentation
test_cases.expected_behavior: Link integrity failure: anchor heading does not exist in target file

test_cases.title: Dead Relative File Link Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts relative file links resolve to an actual file on disk.
test_cases.input_condition: Link `[harness](harnesses/non_existent.md)` in markdown file
test_cases.expected_behavior: Link integrity failure: relative target file does not exist

test_cases.title: Unclosed Markdown Code Fence Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts all markdown code blocks (```) have matching closing fences.
test_cases.input_condition: File opens ```markdown but reaches EOF without closing ```
test_cases.expected_behavior: Markdown syntax failure: unclosed code block detected

test_cases.title: Path Separator Portability Guard
test_cases.description: Asserts documentation links use standard forward slashes rather than Windows backslashes.
test_cases.input_condition: Markdown link contains `harnesses\sizing.md`
test_cases.expected_behavior: Portability warning: links must use forward slashes for cross-platform compatibility

test_cases.title: UTF-8 Encoding Integrity
test_cases.description: Asserts all markdown files are valid UTF-8 without byte order marks or corrupted characters.
test_cases.input_condition: File contains malformed multibyte byte sequence
test_cases.expected_behavior: Encoding failure: file fails UTF-8 decoding

test_cases.title: Runner Non-Existent Directory Handling
test_cases.description: Asserts test runner exits with code 2 when invoked on a non-existent directory.
test_cases.input_condition: python tests/e2e_test_runner.py --repo /non/existent/path
test_cases.expected_behavior: Exits with exit code 2 and outputs user-friendly error message

test_cases.title: Runner Malformed Test Case JSON Handling
test_cases.description: Asserts test runner detects and reports invalid JSON syntax in test case files.
test_cases.input_condition: tier1_feature_coverage.json contains trailing comma or unquoted key
test_cases.expected_behavior: Runner catches json.JSONDecodeError, reports exact line/column, exits code 2

test_cases.title: Runner Non-Zero Exit on Assertion Failure
test_cases.description: Asserts test runner exits with exit code 1 whenever any test assertion fails.
test_cases.input_condition: One test case in suite fails assertion
test_cases.expected_behavior: Runner completes run, logs failed assertion, exits with code 1

test_cases.title: Runner Test Suite Tamper Detection
test_cases.description: Asserts runner verifies test case count invariants to detect deleted assertions.
test_cases.input_condition: Test cases deleted from tier1_feature_coverage.json (e.g. only 60 test cases present)
test_cases.expected_behavior: Runner fails with integrity alert: expected 80 test cases, found 60

test_cases.title: Runner JSON Report Generation Integrity
test_cases.description: Asserts runner `--json-report` generates valid, schema-compliant JSON summary file.
test_cases.input_condition: python tests/e2e_test_runner.py --json-report test_report.json
test_cases.expected_behavior: Outputs valid JSON with total_tests, passed, failed, duration, and timestamp
